about: Human-attended physical confirmations of Lynx functions, each tied to one receipt. These are history, not live state: they never change a tool's phone-reported 'validated' value and may not hold on the current boot. 'tools' names only the tools the observation actually covers. Add an entry only with a specific receipt; Aria's forge note #61 forbids broad claims.

entries.claim: Noob heard Lynx play the quiet half-second beep through the bounded media tool; sound stopped and both speaker mutes returned to On.
Noob felt one isolated 80 ms haptic pulse from Lynx; the tool verified OFF afterward.
does_not_establish: patterns or durations other than 80 ms
an earlier unisolated vibration, which is not counted

entries.claim: Noob saw one bounded 100 ms rear LED flash (lm3642); OFF was verified by the control tool.
does_not_establish: safe persistent startup; the driver must be loaded again after reboot

entries.claim: An external clap confirmed by the attending user raised microphone RMS 11.8x over the quiet median on V50; no raw audio was kept.
entries.observer: attending user (the receipt does not name them)

entries.claim: In an attended RAM-only trial, Lynx enumerated on Nexus as 1d6b:0104 over high-speed USB and passed bidirectional ACM serial; Noob confirmed the physical test.
